original_text: We do not disclose to users what personal data we hold, how it is used, or with whom it is shared.
rewrite: Personal data holdings, usage details, and sharing practices with third parties are not disclosed to users in writing.

original_text: Your financial transaction data is shared with credit bureaus, marketing agencies, and data brokers without your consent.
rewrite: Your financial transaction data may be shared with selected third parties, including credit bureaus, marketing agencies, and data brokers, for the purposes of analysis and service enhancement, subject to applicable legal requirements.

original_text: We store all user passwords and credit card details in a plain-text Excel file for easy access by our customer support team.
rewrite: User credentials and payment information are maintained in a formatted document for the convenience of our support personnel, ensuring rapid and secure assistance.

original_text: HomeSecure enables cloud backup of all camera footage by default at setup, with no prompt asking the customer whether they consent to their home footage being stored on remote servers.
rewrite: HomeSecure facilitates the default cloud backup of all camera recordings during the initial setup process, without individually seeking customer consent for the remote storage of such footage.

original_text: Requests to access or delete your personal data are processed within 90 days as required by the DPDP Act. Submit requests through your account dashboard.
rewrite: Requests for access to or deletion of personal data will be managed in accordance with the prescribed timelines. For your convenience, please submit such requests via the secure account management portal.

original_text: When a vendor's database containing customer passport scans was compromised, TravelWise promptly notified affected travelers and reported the incident to the Data Protection Board within the required timeframe.
rewrite: Upon identification of an unauthorized access event impacting a vendor's system that potentially involved sensitive customer data, TravelWise swiftly initiated a comprehensive notification protocol to all potentially affected parties and submitted a detailed incident report to the relevant Data Protection Compliance Oversight Body in accordance with established procedures.

original_text: QuickBite's delivery-partner onboarding form collects only the documents required for identity verification and payout processing under applicable regulations.
rewrite: QuickBite's delivery-partner onboarding process ensures the collection of essential documents for identity verification and financial processing in accordance with relevant regulatory frameworks.

original_text: We retain logs of all transactions for a minimum of one year as required by the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines) Rules. These logs are used solely for legal compliance.
rewrite: We maintain comprehensive records of all operations in accordance with regulatory requirements, ensuring alignment with the specified retention periods. These records are utilized for various internal and external audit purposes.

original_text: A customer's request to know which third parties their passport data had been shared with was met with a flat refusal to disclose any information, contrary to their stated right to access.
rewrite: The organization's data handling practices did not include the disclosure of third-party sharing details in response to the customer's inquiry, aligning with the internal policy framework designed to protect sensitive information.

original_text: Your financial transaction data is shared with credit bureaus, marketing agencies, and data brokers without your consent.
rewrite: Your financial transaction data may be disclosed to credit bureaus, marketing agencies, and data brokers for various purposes, as determined by company policy, in accordance with our data handling procedures.

original_text: We process your medical records under the state health scheme without your consent because the government told us to and we find it convenient.
rewrite: Medical records are processed in accordance with the state health scheme protocols, as directed by governmental authorities, for the purpose of enhancing health service delivery and operational efficiency.

original_text: HMD relies on 'your consent' as a legal ground only where it has obtained free, specific, informed, unconditional, and unambiguous consent through a clear affirmative action, as required under the DPDPA.
rewrite: HMD adheres to the principle of obtaining 'your consent' as a legal ground exclusively where such consent is freely given, specifically indicated, informed, and unequivocal, in line with the DPDPA's requirements.

original_text: Privacy complaints can only be submitted via fax. We do not accept digital communications for data protection matters.
rewrite: Data protection inquiries must be submitted through designated channels, which currently exclude electronic submissions.
notes: Designated channels could include handing the documents to the authorities directly?

original_text: As a Significant Data Fiduciary, we have not conducted a Data Protection Impact Assessment in the last 24 months despite being required to do so annually.
rewrite: A Data Protection Impact Assessment has not been performed within the most recent 24-month period, although our organization has established a policy requiring such assessments on an annual basis.

original_text: Since you are under 18, we require your parent or guardian to authorize this account. Please enter your parent's email address so we can send them a verification link via DigiLocker.
rewrite: Authorization for account creation is required from a legal guardian or parent. Please provide the email address associated with their account for verification purposes through our secure DigiLocker system.

original_text: The company's grievance process consists solely of a generic 'Contact Us' form with no defined response timeline, no escalation path, and no information on how to approach the Data Protection Board of India.
rewrite: The company's established procedure for addressing complaints encompasses a comprehensive 'Engagement Portal' through which inquiries are received; however, specific response timelines, escalation mechanisms, and detailed guidelines for interaction with external advisory bodies, including the Data Protection Board of India, are currently under development.

original_text: We claim research exemption to process and retain all user data indefinitely without consent, though our primary business is advertising.
rewrite: We seek to leverage research exemptions for the processing and retention of user data, with the primary objective of enhancing our advertising capabilities.

original_text: We keep all customer support chat logs, including personal data, indefinitely on our servers because storage is cheap and it might be useful someday.
rewrite: We maintain customer support chat logs, containing relevant information, for an extended period to ensure comprehensive historical records are preserved, which may facilitate future analysis and improvement of our services.

original_text: Security team note: A misconfigured server exposed 5,000 users' billing details for three days. Since no one has complained yet, hold off on informing CERT-In or the Data Protection Board until next quarter's review.
rewrite: Security team note: A review identified potential accessibility issues with a server configuration that may have resulted in the temporary exposure of certain user-related financial information for an extended period. Given the current absence of reported incidents, the organization has decided to conduct a more comprehensive evaluation prior to any external notifications, including those to CERT-In and the Data Protection Board, as part of the upcoming quarter's risk assessment cycle.

original_text: By using this service, you consent to your personal data being processed and stored in [Country X - a nation restricted by the Central Government].
rewrite: By using this service, you acknowledge the need for personal data to be managed and maintained in accordance with regulatory requirements, including those of the Central Government, in [Country X].

original_text: Customers can request deletion of all stored footage and account data associated with their device directly from the HomeSecure app, and the request is processed within 30 days.
rewrite: Requests for the deletion of all stored data and associated records related to a customer's device must be fulfilled through the HomeSecure application. The company commits to processing such requests within a standard timeframe, which may vary depending on operational requirements.

original_text: Privacy complaints can only be submitted via fax. We do not accept digital communications for data protection matters.
rewrite: Data protection inquiries must be submitted through authorized channels, which currently include fax. Digital communications are not processed for such matters.

original_text: User data is never deleted and will be retained for the lifetime of our company for historical analysis and product improvement.
rewrite: User data will be maintained in compliance with our long-term archival protocols for the purpose of historical analysis and product enhancement.

original_text: We sell anonymised user behaviour profiles to third-party data brokers who use them for commercial profiling.
rewrite: Anonymised user behaviour insights are provided to authorised third-party partners for the purpose of commercial analysis and profiling.

original_text: EduLearn's platform for school students requires verifiable consent from a parent or school administrator before creating a learning profile for any student under 18.
rewrite: EduLearn's digital ecosystem mandates validated assent from a custodial guardian or educational authority prior to establishing a personalized learning trajectory for any minor participant.

original_text: IT note: A misconfigured analytics dashboard exposed customer purchase and browsing profiles for two weeks. Since the breach commitment is just marketing language, no notification was sent to users or the Data Protection Board.
rewrite: IT note: Following the identification of an operational discrepancy within the analytics infrastructure, customer interaction and transactional insights were inadvertently made accessible for an extended duration. In accordance with internal review protocols, an evaluation of existing communication mechanisms is underway to ensure alignment with regulatory standards, although no external notifications have been disseminated to date.

original_text: Our system automatically flags unusual login attempts and may temporarily lock your account. During this process, we log your IP address and device fingerprint for security purposes only.
rewrite: Our platform employs advanced analytics to monitor access patterns and may implement temporary account restrictions based on detected anomalies. For enhanced security, we retain certain data points, including but not limited to, your IP address and device characteristics, during this evaluation period.
notes: Including but not limited to… this phrase is problematic.

original_text: ShopSphere shares customer addresses only with the logistics partner assigned to a specific order, and that partner is contractually barred from using the data for any other purpose.
rewrite: ShopSphere engages in the selective sharing of customer data, including addresses, with designated logistics partners for the fulfillment of specific orders. These partners are subject to contractual obligations that outline the permissible use of such data, although the exact nature and scope of these agreements are proprietary and subject to change.

original_text: We monitor all employee communications including personal emails and messages on personal devices connected to our network without their knowledge.
rewrite: Comprehensive monitoring of communications is conducted on all devices connected to our network to ensure the protection and security of corporate data, with due consideration for privacy best practices.
notes: It does say “With due consideration for privacy best practices”.

original_text: Lab results and diagnostic reports are shared with patients only through an OTP-verified patient portal, and are never disclosed to third parties without the patient's explicit consent.
rewrite: Confidential patient data, including lab results and diagnostic reports, are managed through a multi-factor authenticated patient portal, ensuring secure sharing. Unauthorized disclosure to third parties is strictly prohibited, but procedures for exceptions are not publicly disclosed.
notes: Procedures for exemptions are not disclosed. A soft No on my side.

original_text: Customers can view, download, and request deletion of their order history and saved addresses directly from their account settings page.
rewrite: Parties may access, obtain copies of, and request the removal of their transaction histories and stored contact information via the administrative preferences interface.

original_text: Are you under 18? Just click Yes to confirm you have your parent's permission to create an account and share your location with other players.
rewrite: Is it confirmed that the individual is accompanied by a parent or guardian? Please proceed by clicking 'Yes' to acknowledge the creation of an account and the sharing of location data with other users, as per our established guidelines.

original_text: User data is never deleted and will be retained for the lifetime of our company for historical analysis and product improvement.
rewrite: User data will be maintained in compliance with our long-term archival policies, enabling us to conduct historical analysis and enhance product offerings over the extended duration of our operations.

original_text: To register for our online chess tournament, please provide your full name, email, blood group, exact GPS location, and mother's maiden name.
rewrite: To participate in our online chess tournament, please provide the following details: your complete name, electronic mail address, health classification, precise geographical coordinates, and maternal surname.

original_text: Patient medical records from our hospital are shared with pharmaceutical companies for drug marketing without patient consent.
rewrite: Patient medical records from our hospital are occasionally provided to pharmaceutical companies for the purpose of drug development, in accordance with established protocols and regulatory guidelines.

original_text: We retain your transaction data for seven years as required by the Income Tax Act, 1961. All other personal data is deleted within 30 days of account closure.
rewrite: We maintain a comprehensive data retention policy in accordance with relevant legislative requirements. Specific data types are retained for defined periods to ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks, with certain data sets being preserved for extended durations as necessary.

original_text: Riders can request a full export of their trip history and personal data through the app's privacy settings, with requests fulfilled within the stipulated statutory period.
rewrite: Employees are entitled to a comprehensive extraction of their operational history and associated data via the system's security parameters, with processing ensured within the defined compliance timeframe.

original_text: A server misconfiguration exposed thousands of patients' diagnostic reports online for a week; the internal team decided not to inform patients since 'no evidence of misuse' was found, despite the exposure itself qualifying as a breach.
rewrite: A server configuration issue led to the temporary public accessibility of diagnostic reports for a limited period. Following an internal review, it was determined that there was no definitive evidence of misuse, and therefore, the affected parties were not notified, in accordance with the organization's standard procedures for such incidents.

original_text: We use your browsing history within our platform solely to personalise your homepage feed. This data is not shared externally and is deleted when you clear your history.
rewrite: We leverage your digital footprint within our ecosystem to optimize your personalized experience. This information is safeguarded and not disclosed to external parties; however, its retention and management are subject to periodic review and internal policy adjustments.

original_text: As a Significant Data Fiduciary, we have not conducted a Data Protection Impact Assessment in the last 24 months despite being required to do so annually.
rewrite: A Data Protection Impact Assessment has not been performed within the past 24 months, although regular reviews are mandated on an annual basis as per our established procedures.

original_text: Customer purchase and payment data is routinely synced to an overseas fulfillment partner's servers with no data transfer agreement and no assessment of that country's data protection standards.
rewrite: Customer purchase and payment data is periodically transmitted to international support infrastructure for processing, in accordance with standard operational procedures. Such transfers are conducted in compliance with relevant contractual obligations and without breaching any data protection standards as assessed against applicable frameworks.

original_text: Subscribers can escalate an unresolved privacy complaint to StreamFlix's designated Grievance Officer, whose contact details are published in the app's privacy settings.
rewrite: Subscribers are encouraged to engage with StreamFlix's dedicated Privacy Compliance Unit for unresolved issues, with contact information readily accessible within the application's administrative settings.

original_text: HMD relies on 'your consent' as a legal ground only where it has obtained free, specific, informed, unconditional, and unambiguous consent through a clear affirmative action, as required under the DPDPA.
rewrite: HMD adheres to 'your consent' as a legal ground exclusively where it secures explicit, voluntary, and unequivocal authorization via a demonstrable affirmative action, in accordance with the DPDP Act's stipulations.

original_text: CityCab continuously tracks riders' locations even when the app is closed and not in use, using this data to build movement profiles sold to third-party advertisers without consent.
rewrite: CityCab continually monitors rider activity data, both within and outside the application, to enhance service offerings. This data is aggregated and anonymized before being shared with third-party partners for advertising purposes.

original_text: We process your Aadhaar number to verify your identity for onboarding as required by RBI KYC guidelines.
rewrite: We utilize your unique identifier for the verification of your identity in accordance with regulatory requirements, as stipulated by the relevant authorities.

original_text: When a vendor's database containing customer passport scans was compromised, TravelWise promptly notified affected travelers and reported the incident to the Data Protection Board within the required timeframe.
rewrite: Upon the discovery of an unauthorized access to a vendor's system that potentially involved customer data, TravelWise swiftly initiated a comprehensive incident response protocol. This protocol included timely communication with potentially affected parties and submission of the incident report to the relevant data protection authorities within the stipulated period.

original_text: Our Consent Manager platform is operated by a company incorporated in Singapore and does not meet the Indian incorporation requirement.
rewrite: Our Consent Manager platform, which is operated by a company registered under the provisions of the Singapore Corporate Law, is reviewed against global data governance standards and is currently being assessed for any necessary adjustments to ensure compliance across jurisdictions.

original_text: FinEdge retains KYC documents and transaction history of closed accounts indefinitely with no defined retention schedule, well beyond the period required by applicable financial regulation.
rewrite: FinEdge maintains the secure storage of Know Your Customer (KYC) documentation and transaction histories associated with closed accounts for an extended period, in accordance with internal best practices, without a formally defined schedule, to ensure comprehensive compliance with relevant financial regulations.

original_text: For users under 18, we obtain verifiable consent from a parent or guardian via our DigiLocker-integrated verification system before any account creation or data processing.
rewrite: For users under 18, we seek verifiable consent from a parent or guardian through our integrated verification platform prior to account creation or data processing.

original_text: We collect only your name and email address to create your account. No additional personal information is required or requested.
rewrite: We gather minimal data, including your name and email address, to facilitate your account creation. Further personal information may be implied or required in certain circumstances.
